name: autographcraft
description: Monorepo for AutoGraphCraft - generate an entire GraphQL API from GraphQL schema files
author: AutoGraphCraft <hello@autographcraft.com>

scripts.copyReadMe: for dir in packages/*; do cp README.md README-*.md "$dir/"; done
scripts.copyExamples: for dir in packages/*; do cp -r examples "$dir/"; done
scripts.publishAll: npm run clean -ws && npm run copyFiles && npm publish -w=packages/core && npm publish -w=packages/generate && npm publish -w=packages/mongodb
scripts.generate: npm run compile -ws && npm install && npx autographcraft generate
